# Bundled fonts

Fonts are redistributed from their upstream repositories; the "Changes" column lists any conversion or subsetting. Each font folder contains the upstream license file.

Exports with more than 3 files are not preloaded (marked "no preload"): they still load when used, but Next.js does not preload every weight on every page.

Not using Next.js? Every export also has a plain CSS file (column "CSS"): `import 'next-persian-fonts/css/<name>.css'` declares the `@font-face` rules (same font files), the CSS variable on `:root` and a `.font-<name>` class. The "CSS family" column is the `font-family` name those rules declare.

ⓖ = also available on Google Fonts. These are bundled so they work when Google is unreachable (e.g. during internet shutdowns in Iran) and builds never need to download fonts. Fonts whose license reserves their name (IBM Plex, SIL fonts) are shipped as the authors' unmodified WOFF2 files; the others were converted to WOFF2 and subset to Arabic + Latin characters, which the OFL allows because no Reserved Font Name applies.
